title: Rachana Yadav joins Whirlpool India as Director Legal
description: Rachana Yadav has joined Whirlpool India as Director, Legal & Compliance.Yadav is a 2014 alumna of Dr. Ram Manohar Lohiya National Law University, Lucknow. She earned her LLM in Business Laws from National Law School of India UniversityWith 12 years of expertise, she specializes in contract drafting and negotiation, brand extensions, labeling, risk assessment, due diligence, and compliance with regulatory and advertising laws. Her knowledge extends to self-regulatory bodies such as ASCI
